mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category_id, c.category_name, ( SELECT pi.image_url FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.product_id AND pi.display_order = 1 ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM PRODUCT p JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.parent_category_id = #{categoryId} AND c.category_depth = 2

SELECT P.*, ( SELECT PI.image_url FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.product_id = P.product_id AND PI.display_order = 1 ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.category_id = #{categoryId} LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT image_id, product_id, image_url, image_origin_name, image_name, image_size, image_type, display_order FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( category_id, product_name, product_description, price, stock_quantity, product_status, view_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{productName}, #{productDescription}, #{price}, #{stockQuantity}, #{productStatus}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO PRODUCT_IMAGE ( product_id, image_url, image_origin_name, image_name, image_size, image_type, display_order ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageOriginName}, #{imageName}, #{imageSize}, #{imageType}, #{displayOrder} )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET category_id = #{categoryId}, product_name = #{productName}, product_description = #{productDescription}, price = #{price}, stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, product_status = #{productStatus} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
